title: althaea officinalis subsp. micrantha
intro: Althaea officinalis subsp. micrantha, commonly known as the small-flowered marshmallow or lesser marshmallow, is a subspecies of the marshmallow plant native to Europe and Asia. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include soothing irritated mucous membranes, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Althaea officinalis subsp. micrantha are attributed to its demulcent, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which work together to create a protective barrier on the skin and mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include mucilages, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a popular natural remedy for various health conditions.
